review.body:
Delegated maintainer approval for normal native integration of exact head `b95f48fb9c0d2ff2d66f53fc7b5d0dbda20f25fa`, subject to all existing current-head checks and integration policy. The requested changes are resolved on this concrete candidate.

Independent source review confirmed byte-for-byte tree equality with the preserved runner-authored correction already checked independently, and repeated the representative retained-history tests on this published head. The real history now projects to 128,836 bytes; all 28 original answers remain exhaustively source/hash/byte bound and retrievable, all 64 current file contents/hashes survive, and original input/request authority is unchanged. Mixed-envelope, alias and full-size historical-decision regressions pass. No inferred decision supersession, discarded history, permission expansion, limit increase or provider/product-approval bypass was found. Review used the installed Ponytail guidance and source/evidence comparison; no source implementation was authored by the orchestrator.

Independent full `npm run verify` passed on the identical tree. Fresh native run44025423382 completed preflight, execution, evidence, independent verification and completion successfully; npm install, repository verify, provider citations and strict plan checks all exited0, with clean cleanup. Current-head CI44029185467 and Pages pass. Earlier evidence-overflow/admission failures remain failures in the audit and are not reused as successful checks.

Authorize the supported integration route for this exact head without bypassing enforced checks, freshness or publication gates. Protected package publication, clean consumer adoption and actual installed native qualification remain separate follow-ups. This approval does not claim a delivered application or accept downstream product changes.
